engine_smoke.detail: boot-full v2: full APFS container build (System/Data/Preboot) → REAL-KERNEL STAGE (the actual T8030 iOS 13.7 kernelcache from Apple's CDN: 39 MB LZFSE decode, 6/20 T8030 patches applied to real bytes, real ADT drives device attach 59/105 peripherals, and the pure-Rust A13 interpreter executes the kernel's first real function to a clean RET→HLT from __TEXT_EXEC 0xfffffff007bb0000) → launchd→SpringBoard ladder → 2436x1125 homescreen; PLUS 20 CPU groups with the 189-entry golden table; PLUS real TSS response parse (gs.apple.com capture). Next honest gate: kernel image rebase/fixup load (GOT pointers ship zeroed) to boot past the first indirect call. RE-toolkit session: measured 90.52%→98.59% decode / 90.4%→98.6% exec on the real 18C66 kernel text after porting PAC-branches, 9-bit addressing, STP/LDP pairs+SIMD, exception class, register-offset LS, add-sub-extended, LSLV family; 3 decoder bugs fixed (MOV-alias swallow, LDP/STP opc map, SIMD LS width rule). boot-first lane (2026-10-29): BuildManifest identity select + SHA-384 component verification (DeviceTree == all 4 n104ap identities; KernelCache == release identities [1]/[4]) → staged install (staging-manifest.txt, status 0) → iBoot-equivalent machine assembly from the STAGED bytes → real 18C66 kernel first function: 9 insns retired from 0xfffffff007a18000, clean RET→HLT. M1-ISA session (2026-10-29): bug #8 (dp-3 guard rejected UMULH AND misdecoded SMULH as MADD — wrong results on real bytes) + bug #9 (QEMU-anchored Sqrdmlah goldens were unassigned encodings) fixed; dp-1 family (RBIT/REV16/REV32/REV/CLZ/CLS both widths), dp-3 op31 map, logical-ROR landed with capstone-derived gap goldens; measured 98.59%→98.69% decode (7861938/7966342) / 98.6%→98.7% exec on real 18C66; new oracle tool bucket_discover.py; BOOT-PLAN.md (docs/) now drives the 2h-cadence campaign to homescreen. M1-ISA session D+E (2026-10-29): five remaining families landed with capstone-oracle field maps — SIMD ld/st reg-off+multiple+single structures, indexed by-element FP/INT/FP16FML, scalar FP (fcmp/fcsel/fmov-imm/FCVT family), 2-reg-misc (rev/xtn/fcvtln/fcvtzs-vec/accross-lane-add), permute/dup/ins/ext/tbl, SHA1/SHA256 crypto, PMULL.1q, SIMD literals. REAL-DATA bugs #15 (reduce guard swallowed three-same Vm=16/17), #16 (FCVTL decoded as AESIMC), #17 (ADC family decoded as CSEL — bit23 divider). Measured decode 99.03%→99.31% (7911692/7966342) / exec 99.3% — M1 gate ≥99.3% CLEARED; cargo test --workspace 288 passed / 0 failed. M2 session F (2026-10-29): byte census proved the real 18C66 kernelcache has NO LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS/LC_DYLD_INFO (old-style bare kernel; kernel self-rebases via __thread_starts; __auth_ptr ships pre-signed offsets — valid at slide-0 handoff); the 9-insn boot-first stop was a harness artifact (no handoff state, 20k cap) — rewired to the real iBoot contract (boot_real::run, 12M budget); MEASURED boot-first: 8,135,842 real insns retired (gate ≥10,000 CLEARED), MMU 460 walks / 0 faults, new named stop TranslationFault va=0x4 @ 0xfffffff0081377b4 (kernel /cpus DeviceTree enumeration reading DT globals that ship zero, behind the memory-init gate at 0x…b83f54; live lr=0x…7b8cc0c confirms); REAL-DATA BUG #18 (MAIR_EL1 write dropped → MRS read 0) fixed with gap_mair goldens; sandbox reset #3 mid-session — recovered from S3 vault bundle (HEAD 9130a73); cargo test --workspace 290 passed / 0 failed. M5 session S (2026-10-31): host-OOM class closed for good — Ram is lazily committed (no eager vec![0u8; size]; peak RSS 112 MB for a 10M-insn boot on IOS_RUST_DRAM_MB=1024; semantics pinned incl. the region-end quirks; write_ram_bulk keeps Bus::write_raw/DMA lazy-aware). REAL-DATA BUG #50: AESE/AESD applied the round key AFTER the SubBytes/ShiftRows table — ARM applies it BEFORE (QEMU aese_kernel: 'The Arm AddRoundKey comes first'); found via the fipspost AES-ECB KAT (POST test 4, identified by fipspost_post's per-test error encoding err-1000*test#; KAT key/pt/ct extracted from rodata and python-verified) + the new tests/fips_aes_ecb_kat.rs which runs the kernel's OWN keyexp 0x82a87d0 and vng ECB 0x82cae30 verbatim at real VAs. The old aes_vaes_kat 'ARM-feed' schedule was a circular golden compensating the bug — rewritten kernel-mirroring. Frontier 155,673,736 -> 155,746,479: fipspost_post_aes_ecb returns 0 (KAT PASSED); new wall bug #51 = corecrypto workspace-alloc abort ('alloc ws'/'internal error, file radar to (corecrypto | all)', 0x82b0708) at insn 155,746,369. 463 tests 0 failed. M5 session U (2026-10-31): REAL-DATA BUG #52 — the ADD side of add_with_flags computed the ADCS carry-out as `res < a`, which WRAPS exactly when b == u64::MAX and carry-in is set (a + 2^64 ≡ a → C read 0 for a true carry of 1); the FIPS-POST RSA self-check's PKCS#1 type-01 padded input carries a 24-limb all-ones run (limbs 7..30), so every unrolled ADCS of corecrypto's chains over that run dropped its carry — the measured 6-limb stride-2 −1 diff at the sign/verify compare (boot insn 180,993,288, sign ret −27). Root pinned by the new tests/fips_rsa_kat.rs: the kernel's own ccn_add (0x82cbcd0, Duff's-device unrolled, `adc w0,w0,w0` return) over the captured padded-input limbs reproduces EXACTLY the measured diff pre-fix; fix = two-step overflowing_add carry. RSA key dump fully decoded (n=p·q @+0x18, p@+0x438, q@+0x558, dp@+0x660, dq@+0x6e0, qinv@+0x760, e=3) with a python CRT oracle (S³ mod n == m ✓). Frontier 181,012,637 → 186,277,728: the POST now runs its LATER tests; NEW BUG #53 OPEN = fipspost_post_ecdsa (phase 7, err −7075 = −75−7000): ccec_generate_key_fips (0x82db720) → generate 0x82b0608 OK → validate 0x82c3cb0 → 0x82c5244 sets the fail flag: the generated point is NOT on the P-256 curve. Field cores VERIFIED CORRECT and pinned by tests/fips_ecdsa_kat.rs: mul 0x82b6020 = a·b·R⁻¹ mod p, sqr 0x82b6260 = a²·R⁻¹ mod p (probes: 1·1=R⁻¹, (b·R)·1=b, 2·3=6·R⁻¹; the key ctx stores b in Montgomery form @+0x60, Gx/Gy plain). Suspects: the reduce/convert fn 0x82b6f60 (fold V←V_hi+C0+V_lo·(2³²−2¹⁶⁰) ×3 + branchless cond-sub — semantics still open), the point-mult chain 0x82bd568+, the affine inverse. 481 tests 0 failed (+5 RSA KAT, +2 ECDSA field KAT).
